veinsweep.description: Hold the sneak key (default; rebindable in Controls) while breaking a block to also break the matching blocks connected to it. Ores and logs come out as a whole vein, while dirt, stone and similar blocks break in an irregular patch nearby. It only spreads through the same block type, works with any held item, and can be switched off at any time.
veinsweep.setting.enabled.tooltip: Off: chain mining is fully disabled and breaking a block destroys only that block
veinsweep.command.added: Added %s to the blacklist; it no longer takes part in chain mining.
